usedFor: Pipedrive holds people and deals, and ClickSend SMS receives each new person as a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person Created” in Pipedrive, then “Create Contact” in ClickSend SMS
bestTemplate.why: Each new person lands in a ClickSend contact list, ready for later messages.

watchOut: “New Person Created” in Pipedrive is polling, so “Create Contact” runs after a scheduled check.
